SELECT A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, --상품코드 A.REF_PR_NO AS REF_PR_NO, -- 자재그룹 DECODE(A.REF_PR_NO, '', '', DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE COD2.TYPE = 'M014' AND COD2.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND COD2.CODE = A.REF_PR_NO AND COD2.FLAG = 'Y'), 0, '코드없음', (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE COD2.TYPE = 'M014' AND COD2.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND COD2.CODE = A.REF_PR_NO AND COD2.FLAG = 'Y'))) AS REF_NO_NAME, -- 자재그룹명 B.DESCRIPTION_LOC, --품명 B.SPECIFICATION, --규격 CASE WHEN (SELECT NVL(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N') FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER) = 'Y' then (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = C.AGENT) WHEN (SELECT NVL(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N') FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER) = 'N' then (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRKORE0001') ELSE 'N/A' END AS AGENT_NAME, --공급사 TO_CHAR(NVL(A.CART_QTY,0), 'FM999,999,999,999,999,999') AS CART_QTY, --수량 A.ACCOUNT_TYPE, --계정 DECODE(TRIM(A.ACCOUNT_TYPE), '', '', DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'Z014' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CODE = A.ACCOUNT_TYPE), 0, '코드없음', DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'DTOA' AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND CODE2 = A.ACCOUNT_TYPE AND CODE1 = (SELECT CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'DTOD' AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND CODE2 = A.BUDGET_DEPT AND CODE1 = (SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID))), 0, '예산정보 매핑오류', (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'Z014' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CODE = (SELECT CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'DTOA' AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND CODE2 = A.ACCOUNT_TYPE AND CODE1 = (SELECT CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'DTOD' AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND CODE2 = A.BUDGET_DEPT AND CODE1 = (SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID)))) ) ) ) AS ACCOUNT_TYPE_NAME, -- 계정명 A.BUDGET_DEPT, --예산부서 DECODE(TRIM(A.BUDGET_DEPT), '', '', DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = A.BUDGET_DEPT), 0, '코드없음', DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'DTOD' AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND CODE2 = A.BUDGET_DEPT AND CODE1 = (SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID)), 0, '예산정보 매핑오류', (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CODE = (SELECT CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'DTOD' AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND CODE2 = A.BUDGET_DEPT AND CODE1 = (SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID))) ) ) ) AS BUDGET_DEPT_NAME, -- 예산부서명 CASE WHEN NVL(A.REMARK,' ') <> ' ' then A.REMARK WHEN NVL(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') = ' ' then 'Excel데이타 미등록' WHEN NVL(B.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') = ' ' then '카탈로그 미존재' WHEN NVL(B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,' ') = 'Y' then '단종 품목' WHEN NVL(B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,' ') = 'T' then 'I/F용 품목' WHEN NVL(B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,' ') = 'S' then '신규소싱 단가미합의 품목' WHEN NVL(C.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') = ' ' then '계약서 미존재' END AS REMARK, --비고 C.CONTRACT_NO, --계약번호 C.CONTRACT_SEQ, --계약항번 A.USE_FLAG, --사용유무 A.SEQ, --SEQ CASE WHEN B.CATEGORY_NO IN ( SELECT DISTINCT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ( SELECT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYCA A, ICOMCOD3 B WHERE A.COM_CODE=B.BUYER AND A.COM_CODE = ( SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE (COM_CODE = #{buyer} OR BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{buyer}) ) AND A.COM_CODE = B.TEXT1 AND B.TYPE = 'URCT2' AND B.CODE1 = #{userid} AND B.FLAG = 'Y' AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,1,8) = B.TEXT2 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYCA A WHERE A.COM_CODE = ( SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE (COM_CODE = #{buyer} OR BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{buyer}) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD3 B WHERE B.BUYER = A.COM_CODE AND B.TEXT1 = A.COM_CODE AND B.TEXT2 = SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,1,8) AND B.TYPE = 'URCT2' AND B.FLAG = 'Y' ) ) ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS URCT2_YN FROM ICOMCART_TMP A, ICOMBYIT B, ( SELECT X1.SEQ, X2.CONTRACT_NO, X2.CONTRACT_SEQ, X2.BUYER, X2.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, X2.AGENT, X2.BUYER_ITEM_NO, X2.STATUS FROM ICOMCART_TMP X1, ICOMCQDT X2 WHERE 1=1 AND X1.BUYER = #{buyer} AND X1.USER_ID = #{userid} AND NVL(X1.USE_FLAG,' ') = 'C' AND X1.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = X2.BUYER AND X1.BUYER_ITEM_NO = X2.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND NVL(X2.STATUS,' ') <> 'D' AND X2.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCQDT CQDT WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(CQDT.STATUS,' ') <> 'D' AND CQDT.BUYER = X2.BUYER AND CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = X2.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CQDT.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = X1.BUYER),0,'ABOVE',X1.BUYER) ) C WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.USER_ID = #{userid} AND NVL(A.USE_FLAG,' ') = 'C' AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER(+) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+) AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = C.BUYER(+) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+) AND A.SEQ = C.SEQ(+) AND NVL(B.STATUS(+),' ') <> 'D' AND NVL(C.STATUS(+),' ') <> 'D' AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCART_TMP X1, ICOMCQDT X2 WHERE 1=1 AND X1.BUYER = A.BUYER AND X1.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND X1.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND X1.SEQ = A.SEQ AND NVL(X1.USE_FLAG,' ') = 'C' AND X1.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = X2.BUYER AND X1.BUYER_ITEM_NO = X2.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND NVL(X2.STATUS,' ') <> 'D' AND X2.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCQDT CQDT WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(CQDT.STATUS,' ') <> 'D' AND CQDT.BUYER = A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CQDT.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = A.BUYER),0,'ABOVE',A.BUYER) ) < 2 UNION SELECT A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.REF_PR_NO AS REF_PR_NO, '' AS REF_NO_NAME, B.DESCRIPTION_LOC, B.SPECIFICATION, '' AGENT_NAME, TO_CHAR(NVL(A.CART_QTY,0), 'FM999,999,999,999,999,999') AS CART_QTY, --수량 '' AS ACCOUNT_TYPE, '' AS ACCOUNT_TYPE_NAME, '' AS BUDGET_DEPT, '' AS BUDGET_DEPT_NAME, '해당품목에 대한 계약단가가 2개이상 존재' AS REMARK, '' AS CONTRACT_NO, '' AS CONTRACT_SEQ, 'C' AS USE_FLAG, A.SEQ, '' AS URCT2_YN FROM ICOMCART_TMP A, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCQDT C WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.USER_ID = #{userid} AND NVL(A.USE_FLAG,' ') = 'C' AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER(+) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+) AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = C.BUYER(+) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+) AND NVL(B.STATUS(+),' ') <> 'D' AND NVL(C.STATUS(+),' ') <> 'D' AND 1 < ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCART_TMP X1, ICOMCQDT X2 WHERE 1=1 AND X1.BUYER = A.BUYER AND X1.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND X1.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND X1.SEQ = A.SEQ AND NVL(X1.USE_FLAG,' ') = 'C' AND X1.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = X2.BUYER AND X1.BUYER_ITEM_NO = X2.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND NVL(X2.STATUS,' ') <> 'D' AND X2.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCQDT CQDT WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(CQDT.STATUS,' ') <> 'D' AND CQDT.BUYER = A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CQDT.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = A.BUYER),0,'ABOVE',A.BUYER) ) GROUP BY A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.REF_PR_NO , A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, B.DESCRIPTION_LOC, B.SPECIFICATION, A.BUYER, A.CART_QTY, A.SEQ ORDER BY SEQ

/* setExcelIcomcartAdd */ INSERT INTO ICOMCART( BUYER, USER_ID, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ, USE_FLAG, BUYER_ITEM_NO, SEQ, AGENT, CART_QTY, BYIT_COMORG_CODE, REF_PR_NO, BUDGET_DEPT, ACCOUNT_TYPE, UNIT_PRICE, CREATE_DATE, REG_DATE, SIZE_QTY, SIZE_LEN ) SELECT A.BUYER, A.USER_ID, C.CONTRACT_NO, C.CONTRACT_SEQ, A.USE_FLAG, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT DECODE(MAX(SEQ),NULL,'0', MAX(SEQ))+1 FROM ICOMCART WHERE BUYER = #{buyer} AND USER_ID = #{userid} AND USE_FLAG = 'C') AS SEQ, CASE WHEN (SELECT NVL(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N') FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER) = 'Y' THEN C.AGENT WHEN (SELECT NVL(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N') FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER) = 'N' THEN 'KRKORE0001' ELSE 'N/A' END AS AGENT, --공급사 TO_NUMBER(A.CART_QTY) AS CART_QTY, A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE,
A.REF_PR_NO, (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 0, NULL, A.BUDGET_DEPT) FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'DTOD' AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND CODE1 = (SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AND CODE2 = A.BUDGET_DEPT), (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 0, NULL, A.ACCOUNT_TYPE) FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'DTOA' AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND CODE1 = (SELECT CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'DTOD' AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND CODE1 =(SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AND CODE2 = A.BUDGET_DEPT) AND CODE2 = A.ACCOUNT_TYPE),
A.REF_PR_NO AS REF_PR_NO, '' AS BUDGET_DEPT, --BUDGET_DEPT '' AS ACCOUNT_TYPE, --ACCOUNT_TYPE
C.TARGET_PRICE, SYSDATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_NUMBER(A.SIZE_QTY) AS SIZE_QTY, TO_NUMBER(A.SIZE_LEN) AS SIZE_LEN FROM ICOMCART_TMP A, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCQDT C WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.USER_ID = #{userid} AND A.SEQ = #{SEQ} AND NVL(A.USE_FLAG,' ') = 'C' AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = C.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND NVL(B.STATUS,' ') <> 'D' AND NVL(C.STATUS,' ') <> 'D' AND NVL(A.REMARK,' ') = ' ' --Validation Error가 없는건 AND C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER = C.BUYER AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND BELOW_COMORG_CODE =A.BUYER AND STATUS ^= 'D'),0,'ABOVE',A.BUYER)
